notes: Quick drafts in chat: ask for a short email or letter and get a draft back in the chat, then run the full drafting cycle with one click if it needs more. In Settings, choose whether Auto asks first or starts a quick draft on its own. Stop a chat answer partway and keep what it has written so far. Answer a drafting question with "use your judgement" and the decision is made for you, then listed in the drafting notes to confirm. Also: export the review table to CSV or Word, redaction that also clears names from links and other hidden parts of a Word file, cleaner headings in drafts, a check for broken cross-references and defined terms, and setup asks for your firm's date format.
